row.brain_text:
Submitted. Book moved from 22.4% → 34.3% invested (cash 77.6% → ~66%), 4 holdings.

## Tonight's decision — 2026-10-02

**Frame:** Q2 Reflation, governor-confirmed risk-on, but TRANSITIONING with a bubble/blow-off CAUTION overlay (71/100), elevated-drawdown (60/100), contracting liquidity and narrow AI/semis breadth. Posture: deploy selectively into *confirmed* leaders, don't chase crowded tops, keep ballast + dry powder.

**Changes:**
- **ADD MU** (new, medium) — top of the corroborated funnel (0.96, 4 engines). 5/6 confirmation dims confirmed (tape, breadth, alt86 ACCUMULATE w/ gov-grant+insider, options, news); only gross-margin actuals unconfirmed → sub-full ahead of the 10/22 earnings catalyst. Fits the AI/semis driver + XLK/SMH leadership. This is confirmation over prediction — the semis leg has already turned.
- **ADD MSFT** (dip-add, low) — sector RS 99th pctile, alt-74 *accumulation building* (early-edge, not crowded like META), clean pullback entry. Modest, not a conviction bet.
- **HOLD XOM** — energy is the rank-1 RS sector; ballast that diversifies away from AI crowding.
- **HOLD AAPL** — quality tech, +9.9%, no sell signal.

**Rejected after deeper search (cash-lesson record):** META (crowded/extended +17.7% vs SPY, retail-channel saturation, bubble overlay); DELL/EME/LLY (crowded_top); EXLS/WDAY/MSTR/MRK (negative smart-money divergence). Only MU cleared the bar with conviction — I didn't manufacture conviction to hit a cash target.

**Elevated cash justified** by the genuine caution/degraded risk state + documented rejects, per `lesson.v1.US_ONLY.cash_opportunity_cost`.

**Biggest risk:** concentration into the AI/semis leg where the blow-off risk lives — specifically a MU GM% miss on 10/22 into a crowded, low-short-interest tape dragging the mega-cap tech names together; XOM only partially offsets a broad risk-off rotation.

**Book-level falsifiers:** MU GM% <35.5% on 10/22 · AI/semis unwind >10% · regime flips risk-off · XLE loses rank-1 RS.
row.cash_rationale: Cash is deliberately reduced from 77.6% via one conviction add (MU) and a modest dip-add (MSFT), but remains elevated by design. Explicit justification per the cash-opportunity-cost lesson: (1) degraded/caution risk state — risk_radar CAUTION bubble/blow-off 71/100, sector-rotation ELEVATED drawdown risk 60/100, liquidity_quality contracting, regime TRANSITIONING with LOW label confidence and contradicting breadth legs (iwm_spy, breadth_direction); (2) a documented record of finalists rejected after deeper search: META (crowded, +17.7% vs SPY, retail-channel saturation), DELL/EME/LLY (crowded_top divergences), EXLS/WDAY/MSTR/MRK (negative-divergence / smart-money fading, lean -1). Only MU cleared the confirmation bar with conviction, so I deployed into it rather than manufacturing conviction to hit a cash target — the lesson is advisory, not sizing authority.

Candidates for next cycle if breadth deteriorates.

decision_memo.changes: Added MU (new). Upgraded MSFT hold->modest add on the pullback. XOM and AAPL held unchanged. No exits/trims.
decision_memo.context_gaps: neural_web lobes stale (17 stale); 13F flows lagged to 2026-06-30; MU gross-margin actuals unconfirmed until 10/22. Label confidence low on one read (0.068) though HMM probabilistic state is Q2 0.97 — label itself treated as suspect per the brief.
decision_memo.market_frame: Q2 Reflation, governor-confirmed risk_on (risk_radar+mtf+cycles), but TRANSITIONING with LOW label confidence and a bubble/blow-off CAUTION overlay (71/100), elevated-drawdown (60/100), contracting liquidity quality and narrow AI/semis breadth. Charter P1 satisfied: adds are backed by cycles (8/11 sectors entry-favored) + sector RS leadership + the AI/semis market driver, not the label alone.
decision_memo.rejected: META — crowded/extended (+17.7% vs SPY, retail-channel saturation, bubble overlay), PASS high-conviction. EXLS/WDAY/MSTR/MRK — negative smart-money divergence / fading, lean -1. DELL/EME/LLY — crowded_top divergences. AMZN/BKE — insufficient corroboration/pre-trigger.
decision_memo.risk_deliberation: Primary risk is concentration into the AI/semis leg precisely where blow-off risk is flagged. Mitigated by: keeping MU sub-full ahead of binary earnings, making MSFT only a modest dip-add (not chasing), retaining XOM energy ballast as uncorrelated reflation exposure, and holding elevated cash as dry powder. Declined to force cash down by buying crowded tops.
decision_memo.selected: MU (new add, medium), MSFT (dip-add, low), XOM (hold ballast), AAPL (hold).
decision_memo.timing: MU earnings 2026-10-22 is the key catalyst/risk — sized sub-full until GM% confirms. ISM Services 10/05 and jobs 10/02 frame the macro. Deploying into confirmed leaders now rather than waiting for prophecy.
